title: [v0.91.8][WP-21] Queue Adaptive Learning DAG work
body:
## Summary

- Adds the v0.92 Adaptive Learning DAG queue and wires it into the v0.92 planning surfaces.
- Records #5107 C-SDLC v2 lifecycle state, deterministic preparation validation, and exact-head review evidence.
- Keeps #5104 as historical loop-runtime input only until requalified against current Runtime v3 contracts; this PR does not implement adaptive learning or learning-driven graph mutation.

## Validation

- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5107/validate_preparation.rb`
- `csdlc-validate finalize` with evidence in `.csdlc/evidence/5107/preparation-doc-contract.log`
- `csdlc-review guard` ready at current metadata-only head

## Review

- Exact-head review: `codex:bounded-exact-head-review`
- Reviewed revision: `git-blake3:41b33d89f52383a1da075668010e327e6650a098:e38eaff4beb1b501723fafa0d68308630eb24a993a587a13607b1de684267878`
- Finding fixed: Runtime v3 authority wording for the #5104 loop-runtime input.

## Residual Risks / Blockers

- Shared v0.92 planning files remain stack-sensitive; #4761 currently owns `docs/milestones/v0.92/DEMO_MATRIX_v0.92.md`, so the #5107 typed claim was narrowed to lifecycle artifacts and adaptive-learning feature paths.
- Adaptive-learning implementation, graph mutation, child issue creation, merge, and closeout remain out of scope.

Closes #5107
